title: Agentic Meta lead-gen campaigns without living in Ads Manager
one_liner: Coding agents + computer-use spin Meta pixels/system users/organic job-photo creatives into local lead-gen campaigns without living in Ads Manager.
why_agent_runnable: Campaign scaffolding, creative generation, and browser ops are agent-native. Brandon owns ad account identity, budgets, and final publish.

ops_steps.title: Account + niche prerequisites
ops_steps.detail: Checklist: BM/ad account status, pixel needs, local niche creative angles (job-photo + text bubble).

ops_steps.title: Brandon account access
ops_steps.detail: Provide/approve Business Manager access; KYC; set hard budget ceiling.

ops_steps.title: Agentic campaign scaffold
ops_steps.detail: Scripts/skills to create campaign structure, audiences, and lead forms — dry-run until money gate.

ops_steps.title: Organic job-photo creatives
ops_steps.detail: Generate image/video variants with text-bubble overlays; batch for tests.

ops_steps.title: Launch approval
ops_steps.detail: Approve creatives, budget, and go-live; no auto-spend.

ops_steps.title: Lead CRM + reply drafts
ops_steps.detail: Pipe leads to sheets; draft SMS/email; Brandon send.

ops_steps.title: Optimize + productize
ops_steps.detail: Kill losers, scale winners within ceiling; package as internal skill or client offer (publish gate).

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.target_metric_notes: Track CPL and cost-per-qualified-booked-call — thresholds set by Brandon per niche.
unit_economics_sketch.tooling_notes: Coding agent + computer-use reduce Ads Manager time; still need compliant ad account.
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: If sold as service, retainer on top of media. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 2: Brandon BM access + budget ceiling
Day 3-4: campaign scaffold dry-run + creative batch
Day 6-7: leads CRM + reply drafts (no send without gate)
kill_criteria: Ad account restricted and cannot remediate within 14 days
CPL above Brandon ceiling for 14 consecutive days at test budget
Lead quality too poor to book calls after 50 leads
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
